asked QB4-003: QB4-002 lets also_present list a theme a reader listed under its own also_present. Should such themes also count in the bag test? My test: an item is a bag when four or more themes have three concepts of their own; a bag places one theme and lists the others under also_present (your bag rule). I have counted placed themes only (the two readings' lists and my B1). Counting named themes too would turn 43 rulings in packets 1 to 5 into bags (36 of them in packet 5), each placing one theme instead of two or three. Example: theblackvoid t02, where reading A flagged a bag (T3-084, with T3-139, T3-150, T3-149 and T3-046 under its also_present), reading B placed T3-149, and my ruling placed T3-084 and T3-149. 26 existing bags could also list further named themes. | meanwhile: The bag test counts placed themes only, as in packet 5; also_present lists named themes only inside bags made that way. Packet 6 is ruled so. out/_analysis/b4_bag_named_check.py lists the lines that would change, so the change can be applied if you rule otherwise.
